title: The Death of Chivalry
start: Speak to Sir Owen at the Edgeville Monastery west of Edgeville.

items.t: 5 free backpack space (for an armour set)
Combat equipment (not required from the start, able to retrieve from the bank when necessary)

recommended.t: Talk to the Saradominist preacher west of Lumbridge Castle at the memorial fountain and watch the opening and finale cutscenes from the Battle of Lumbridge
12 free backpack slots for an armour set and ritual materials

kills.t: Enemies with life points and attacks that scale to your level.
Dawn, and several groups of summoned skeletons

rewards.t: 500 Combat XP lamp (usable on one of the skills: scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Necromancy )
rewards.l: Combat XP lamp (The Death of Chivalry)

rewards.t: 4 Knightly titles (you are suggested one based on choices made during the quest, but you can pick any one at any time through the title interface)
Sir Owen Sonde's shield with an emote that may be performed while the shield is equipped

Skull of Remembrance that gives the ability to replay this quest's cinematic cutscenes (in a few locations only), teleport to the Black Knight ritual chamber, and to re-battle Dawn when used on her body
Dawn's key, which opens Captain Dulcin's journal
The ability to loot the 8 dead Black Knights for more coins if you did not do so during the quest
The ability to loot Lieutenant Graves for more coins and dispose of his body if you did not do so during the quest

steps.t: Speak to Sir Owen in the garden north of the Edgeville Monastery. [Chat: 1 The who with the what now? › 1 I guess I have one of those faces. › 1 Saradomin must have had a good reason...]
p: Saradomin informs you of your mission.

steps.t: Talk to Saradomin after the cutscene. [Chat: 1 (Kneel before Saradomin.) › 2 How can I help? › Accept]
Alternatively if aligned with another god. [Chat: 1 (Remain standing.) › Any › Any › Accept]
Pick up the suit of armour just south-west of you and equip it.
p: Place: Suit of armour (The Death of Chivalry)

steps.t: Talk to Saradomin. [Chat: 1 Yes, teleport us to the Black Knights' Fortress.]
Open the Portcullis.
Fortress guard: (guaranteed suspicion on first chat option) [Chat: Any › 1 He is my prisoner. › 1 No, I have something... special planned for him.]

sub.t: It is required to dismiss pets and familiars before proceeding.

p: Preparing to perform a stealth operation on the Black Knights' Fortress.

steps.t: Head north, to Lieutenant York: [Chat: 2 Are you suggesting I cannot handle a mere knight of Saradomin?]
Head north-west, and climb up staircase. The fortress guard will stop you. [Chat: 1 What do you want, maggot? › 2 This prisoner is to be sacrificed.]
Head to the floor 2 to the south, talk to Hierophant Marius. [Chat: 2 Yes. › 3 I shall return after I deal with this Temple Knight.]
Head south-east of the room, and climb up staircase. The fortress guard will stop you. [Chat: 2 I am bringing him to the tallest tower. › 1 We need him to recover the weapon of power, as you know.]
Go upstairs, head north to Lieutenant Graves. [Chat: 3 Stand aside. I will handle this. › 1 The prisoner stays with me.]
Search the Lieutenant's body, and choose whether you want to kill him or not. It doesn't matter.
Head up the stairs in the north-east to the ritual chamber.
Search the wardrobe for a Letter from Lord Daquarius.
Search the box of candles for three red candles.
Search the shelf for chalk.
Pick up the Grimoire and read it. [Chat: 1 Read the book.]
Use a candle on each stand, and fix the symbol on the floor.
Light the candles.
Use chalk on Ritual circle.
Chant over the north-west candle. [Chat: 3 Arom. › 4 Nahrea. › 2 Imperium.]
Chant over the north-east candle. [Chat: 2 Feritas. › 4 Silenti. › 2 Sepulchrum.]
Chant over the south-east candle. [Chat: 4 Igasac. › 2 Perdimit. › 4 Ebulam.]
Enter the portal. [Chat: 1 Yes, enter the portal.]

sub.t: You must remove the suit of armour that was equipped at the beginning of the quest.

steps.t: Defeat the three Black Knights.
Search their bodies for Cage door key.
Unlock the hanging cage to the north, freeing the Damsel.
Talk to Dawn and learn all she knows. [Chat: 1 Where are we? › 2 Who's Saint Elspeth? › 3 How did the Kinshra capture you? › 4 Continue. › 1 Let's take her with us.]
Search the supply crate south of the portal.
Enter the doorway to the east.
Inspect the coffins or the heaps of bones.
p: The Black Knights torturing a damsel
Fighting the Black Knights with Sir Owen

steps.t: Open the portcullis to the south.
Search the Black Knight's bodies.
Talk to Fern and defeat her. [Chat: 3 I am ready to be judged. › 1 I fight to protect the innocent. › 2 I'm ready.]

sub.t: If The Restless Ghost has been completed, [Chat: 4 I am ready to be judged. › 1 I fight to protect the innocent. › 2 I'm ready.]

steps.t: Head south, to the Wand of Resurrection.
Solve the puzzle by matching the tiles to lower the barrier.

sub.t: The image of the completed puzzle is taken with the compass facing south.

p: Breaching the ward with your blood.

steps.t: Try to take the wand. A chat option appears. Select offer to risk your life. [Chat: 2 I shall sacrifice my own blood. › 1 Yes.]
Head north. Talk to Dawn. [Chat: 3 Give me the wand or you won't live to regret it. › 2 Continue]
Defeat the Black Knights and Sir Owen.
p: The Black Knights and Sir Owen come back as Zombies!

steps.t: Go north and open the portcullis.
Kill Dawn. Refer to the full guide if you're having trouble.
Search Dawn's body.
Head south, enter the Portcullis and speak with Saradomin. [Chat: 4 I've made my decision. › 2 I will give you the wand. › 2 Were we too late? › Any › 2 Why would you help us? › Any]

When Saradomin asks if the player wants to be teleported back to Edgeville, it is recommended to stay in the tombs, to claim the extra post-quest rewards which require level 40 Strength and two other coffins requiring level 60 and 80 Strength.
p: Saradomin takes the wand from the player by force.
Saradomin with the wand of resurrection.
Saradomin uses the wand to revive Sir Owen.
Saradomin accidentally corrupts a part of Sir Owen.

steps.t: Quest complete!

pic: Sir Owen — East of Ice Mountain
